display.title: Episode 363: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 8 (Beis Adar)
display.summary_short: On his mother's yahrzeit Uncle Yossi tells of the broken esrog; two sisters lead the Shema; and Yehudah meets the old man in the forest cabin, a hidden tzaddik.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Beis Adar 5749, the yahrzeit of Uncle Yossi's mother. He tells how, as a girl of seven, she took her father's beautiful esrog and lulav from house to house on Hoshana Rabbah so others could do the mitzvah; when the tip broke, a kind tailor 'fixed' it with a needle, and her father laughed and did not scold her. With the joy of Adar comes the Hakochainik march. Story time recaps Peter's dream and explains hashgachah pratis; two sisters from Beis Rivka then lead the Shema. In the chapter, Yehudah slips away to the lake in the forest, peeks into the cabin, and finds the old man from his dream reading an old book. Uncle Yossi explains what a tzaddik nistar, a hidden tzaddik, is. The old man tells Yehudah he is Jewish and that his parents lost him twelve years ago; there is much to learn before he can return to them. The mailbox features a girl's Shiviti sign drawing, followed by the new Simcha Club and Shabbos times.
display.lesson: Hashem watches over every Jew with hashgachah pratis, and a mitzvah shared with others brings true joy.
